observations.title: Embeddium role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Replaces the client terrain-rendering implementation with a Sodium-derived Forge-compatible renderer; its bundled integrations must be distinguished from installing Sodium or Indium independently.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
